title: The Earth Hotel
content: Started a podcast about this topic in 2014 after my own study and dreams. Been looking for this kind of group forever. I don’t profit from it, no ads etc. just wanted to share for confirmation. Our world and its total system have warped everything, from our environment to our dream spaces. The podcast is my exploration of this idea and the sub-world we see in these dreams.[The Earth Hotel Podcast](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/the-earth-hotel/id1161287170?i=1000519032176)
